name: tiny-smile-ai
title: Tiny Smile AI
description: AI emoji search for Tinycast: describe a mood or situation and pick from fitting emojis suggested by your Tinycast AI model.
author: hendrik77

commands.name: ai-emoji-search
commands.title: AI Emoji Search
commands.subtitle: Tiny Smile AI
commands.description: Find the best fitting emoji for any situation using the AI model configured in Tinycast.

preferences.name: channel
preferences.title: Tinycast Channel
preferences.description: Which Tinycast install to read the AI settings from.

preferences.name: resultCount
preferences.title: AI Suggestions
preferences.description: How many emojis to ask the AI for.

preferences.name: minimizeThinking
preferences.title: Speed
preferences.label: Fast answers (minimize model thinking)
preferences.description: Ask thinking models to reason as little as possible, using the lowest level declared for the model in Tinycast.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Enter does with the selected emoji.

preferences.name: skinTone
preferences.title: Skin Tone
preferences.description: Skin tone applied to emojis that support one.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Name Search Language
preferences.description: Extra language for the instant name matches. English is always searched.

preferences.name: useSelection
preferences.title: Selected Text
preferences.label: Use the selected text when the command starts
preferences.description: The selection of the frontmost app is used as the first search and sent to the AI like typed text. Nothing is read when you give the command an argument.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
